# AL&CO, Arslan Larik & Company

> Arslan Larik & Company (AL&CO), the Center for Human Brilliance and Behavioral Reengineering: world-class NLP, hypnosis and coaching certification, taught live on Zoom. Six levels, from NLP Practitioner to NLP Master Trainer. 2,000+ graduates across 20+ countries, nearing 100 batches, and counting. Our work has inspired over a million lives.

## Key facts
- Delivery: fully live on Zoom, taught personally. Sessions run 8:00pm to 2:00am Pakistan Standard Time (PKT). Cohorts of 20 to 25; Level 3 is never more than 20.
- Certification boards: ABNLP (AL&CO is an ABNLP Approved Institute of NLP), the ABNLP Coaching Division (Approved Institute of NLP Coaching), ABH (Approved School of Hypnosis), TLTA (Time Line Therapy® Techniques) and NGH (USA). ANLP (UK) provides CPD accreditation; it is not a certifying board.
- Levels 1 and 2 carry quad certification (ABNLP, ABNLP Coaching Division, TLTA and AL&CO's own Certified Practitioner of Behavioral Reengineering) plus one UK ANLP CPD accreditation.
- Manuals: Levels 1, 2 and 3 each include a manual of about 500 pages (at Level 3, alongside the ABH and NGH professional library), issued digitally and the graduate's to keep. E-copies are encouraged; a printed set is available and charged separately.
- Audio: audio files are provided to students as a library on AL&CO's online learning portal: 222 at Level 1 and 225 at Level 2. Level 3 has none.
- Free revisits for five years at Levels 1 to 3.
- Minimum age: 14, with parental or guardian consent.
- Investment: no figures are published. Each pathway is arranged in a conversation with a relationship manager.

## Programs
- [All Programmes](https://arslanlarik.com/programs): the six-level ladder at a glance.
- [Level 1: NLP Practitioner](https://arslanlarik.com/program/nlp-practitioner): 10 days, 130 hours; quad certification plus UK ANLP CPD; no prerequisite.
- [Level 2: NLP Master Practitioner](https://arslanlarik.com/program/nlp-master-practitioner): 13 days, 140 hours; quad certification at master level plus a second ANLP CPD; requires Level 1.
- [Level 3: Advanced Hypnotherapy and Interventionist](https://arslanlarik.com/program/advanced-hypnotherapy-interventionist): 13 days: 12 days of live teaching, plus one mandatory day in between for assignments set by AL&CO. ABH Certified Practitioner and Master Practitioner of Hypnosis, NGH certification and membership; requires Level 2 and an interview.
- [Level 4: NLP Train the Trainer](https://arslanlarik.com/program/nlp-trainers-training-program): 18 days (14 training and 4 evaluation), 120 hours; Certified Trainer of NLP (ABNLP); requires Level 2; by interview.
- [Level 5: Hypnosis Train the Trainer](https://arslanlarik.com/program/hypnosis-trainers-training-program): 8 days; Certified Hypnosis Trainer (ABH); requires Level 3; by interview.
- [Level 6: NLP Master Trainer](https://arslanlarik.com/program/nlp-master-trainer-program): three to five years, by application, interview and Board evaluation; Certified Master Trainer of NLP (ABNLP). The sign-off by two Master Trainers is AL&CO's own standard.
- [Free weekly webinar](https://arslanlarik.com/free-webinar): a free, live introductory hour on Zoom for people new to AL&CO.
- [Private coaching with Arslan Larik](https://arslanlarik.com/one-on-one-coaching-sessions): one-on-one coaching, exclusive to Arslan.

## About
- [Who is Arslan Larik](https://arslanlarik.com/about-us/who-is-arslan-larik): Founder and Master Trainer. Pakistan's first Certified Master Trainer of NLP (ABNLP) and Certified Hypnosis Master Trainer (ABH); ANLP Accredited Master Trainer (UK); ANLP International Ambassador for Pakistan; Master Trainer of NLP University (NLPU). Lineage: The Tad James Company, in the tradition of Dr Tad James and Dr Adriana James; Master Trainer under Robert Dilts at NLP University (recognised 2025). The NLPU title is Arslan's personal credential: AL&CO is not an NLP University affiliate and its students do not receive NLPU certificates. Training and coaching since 2010; AL&CO established as an institution in 2018.
- [Who is Bismillah Pervez](https://arslanlarik.com/about-us/who-is-bismillah-pervez): Bismillah Pervez, CEO, ICF Master Certified Coach (MCC), ACTC, and ANLP Accredited Master Trainer (UK).
